name: 360Learning

sources.title: Create a course by importing an eLearning file

bestFormat.why: SCORM 2004 2nd to 4th editions are processed and suspend_data is kept as sent (64,000 characters in the 3rd and 4th). cmi5, which the vendor recommends, cannot be previewed, and xAPI courses are left out of OPCO reports.

update.notes: Replacing the package loses progress; suspend_data of non-completed learners is erased.

notes: xAPI courses are excluded from OPCO funding reports: deliver SCORM or cmi5 to French clients.
cmi5 recommended by the vendor but without preview; launchMethod AnyWindow.
Package limits: 4 GB once extracted, 50,000 files, compression ratio 200; no limit on the size of the ZIP itself.
SCORM 2004 4th edition: cmi.progress_measure shows the progress of an attempt in progress; completion needs cmi.completion_status completed.
